message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a large, dark blue and white multi-decked luxury yacht. A small, stylized person with a round face, wearing an orange shirt and black pants, sits on the aft deck holding a fishing rod. The fishing line extends into the water below, where it appears to be hooked onto a massive, dark grey metal vault door that forms the submerged hull of the ship. The vault door has circular gears and a large locking wheel.

Two scuba divers in black gear are visible underwater to the left of the vault. The background shows a pale blue sky with faint clouds above the waterline and a darker blue-grey underwater scene below.

Legible text includes the large title "TEMPO" across the top. Smaller headlines read "MENJERAT JARINGAN PENYEBAR HOAKS" and "KISRUH SELEKSI KOMISIONER KPPU". The main headline in large black letters is "PESIAR RASUAH 1MDB". A block of text below this reads: "DIDUGA DIBELI DENGAN UANG KORUPSI, KAPAL MALAYSIA DISITA POLISI DI BALI. PEMILIKNYA ORANG DEKAT PERDANA MENTERI NAJIB RAZAK." A barcode and date "12-18 MARET 2018" are in the bottom right.
